'''''Star Wars Adventures''''' is an anthology [[Star Wars comic books|comic book]] series set in the ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]]. The [[IDW Publishing]] series features stories from the entirety of ''Star Wars'' and is intended for all ages. The first issue was released digitally on [[July 12]], [[2017]] on [[StarWars.com]] and was later released physically as a part of a [[Wikipedia:San Diego Comic-Con|San Diego Comic-Con]] (SDCC) promotion, while the regular series officially launched on [[September 6]]. On [[January 3]], [[2018]], IDW also published a [[Star Wars: Forces of Destiny (comic series)|spinoff weekly miniseries based]] on the [[Star Wars Forces of Destiny|''Forces of Destiny'']] animated micro-series.<ref name="FoD">{{WebCite|url=https://ew.com/books/2017/10/06/star-wars-adventures-forces-of-destiny-comic|text=''Star Wars Adventures: Forces of Destiny'' comic will highlight the saga's heroines|author=Holub, Christian|date=2017-10-06|archivedate=20190604155030}}</ref> The trade paperback of the [[Star Wars: The Weapon of a Jedi|''Weapon of a Jedi'']] German comics published by [[Panini]] Verlag is titled [[Star Wars Adventures: The Weapon of a Jedi (German TPB)|''Star Wars Adventures: The Weapon of a Jedi'']].<ref name="BibliothekTPBNews">{{WebCite|url=https://jedi-bibliothek.de/2017/11/panini-buecher-comicbaende-1-halbjahr-2018|text=Panini: Die Bücher und Comicbände im 1.
